title: Can Cities Have Personalities? Introducing the SCD City Personality Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2611.30733v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Descriptions of cities are shaped by human experience and institutional narratives. We introduce the SCD City Personality Assessment (SCD-CPA), a method that instantiates document-grounded ChatGPT city personas and interrogates each with an identical 24-statement instrument inspired by the four-pair structure of the Myers-Briggs Type Indicator. Rather than asking a general-purpose model to characterize cities freely, we configure a separate document-grounded conversational agent for each city and use alternative evidence portraits to compare documentary inputs. The resulting four bipolar dimensions and four-letter summaries use independently defined urban concepts and scoring rules. translated_title: 城市可以有个性吗？SCD城市个性评估的提出
translated_abstract: 城市的描述受到人类经验和制度叙事的塑造。我们提出了SCD城市个性评估（SCD-CPA），这是一种实例化基于文档的ChatGPT城市人格化身，并使用受迈尔斯-布里格斯类型指标（MBTI）四对结构启发的相同的24项陈述工具对每个城市进行询问的方法。不同于让通用模型自由地刻画城市特征，我们为每个城市配置一个独立的基于文档的对话代理，并使用替代证据画像来比较不同的文档输入。由此产生的四个双极维度和四字母摘要使用了独立定义的城市概念和评分规则。东京、纽约和巴黎构成了方法论评估（在重复会话、三种GPT-6努力设置和替代画像下共进行33次评估）：东京的原始画像在设置内项目精确一致性达到85.4%，而证据替换...
tldr: 该论文提出SCD城市个性评估方法，通过为每个城市构建基于文档的ChatGPT人格化身，并使用受MBTI启发的24项标准化评估工具和四个双极维度，实现对城市个性特征的系统化量化测评。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the SCD City Personality Assessment, a method that instantiates document-grounded ChatGPT city personas and evaluates each with an MBTI-inspired 24-statement instrument across four bipolar dimensions to systematically quantify city personality traits.
